title: Minshop client manifest, schema version 1

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest format. Bumped only by the core.

coreVersion.description: Core version (SemVer tag) this shop was cloned from or last upgraded to.

slug.description: Fleet-wide identifier. Becomes part of every Cloudflare resource name.

displayName.description: Human name of the shop, as shown to operators.

locale.description: Storefront locale. Single-valued while the offer is France-only.

timezone.description: Business time zone used for order timestamps and reports.

currency.description: Settlement currency. Multi-currency is out of scope.

market.description: Market the shop is certified for.

checkoutMode.description: Checkout mode. Guest-only until customer accounts are certified.

defaultVatRate.description: Default French VAT rate applied when a product declares none.

invoiceStrategy.description: Billing document strategy. `pending-validation` means the accounting review of plan §6 (jalon 3) has not happened yet.

features.description: Feature switches decided at build time. Runtime toggles live in Admin → Réglages.

semanticSearch.description: Vector search. Out of scope for the pilot (plan §2.2).

digitalProducts.description: Downloadable products served from the private bucket.

shipping.description: Physical shipping and its rate table.

cloudflare.description: Runtime home of the shop. Every name here is account-visible.

jurisdiction.description: D1 and R2 jurisdiction. EU-only while the offer is French (ADR 0004).

workerName.description: Worker name, and the stem of every other resource name. Must be `minshop-<slug>`.

productionDomain.description: Custom production domain of the storefront.

accountId.description: Cloudflare account this shop is provisioned in. Written once provisioning has confirmed it; `shopctl provision` refuses to run against any other account. Not a credential — it is in the URL of every dashboard page — and it is what makes "wrong account" a refusal rather than a discovery.

productionAccountId.description: Cloudflare account production lives on, when it is not `accountId`. ADR 0015 builds staging on the agency's account and puts production on the client's, and both exist at once from the moment the client starts entering content until the agency copy is torn down. Absent, production lives on `accountId` like everything else.

imagesDomain.description: Public custom domain of the images bucket, when one is attached. Absent means product images are served through the Worker, which is the default and is never wrong — only slower.

stagingDomain.description: Hostname the staging environment answers on, so an Access application can be put in front of it. Absent means staging is served on workers.dev, which CANNOT be gated: the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header is forgeable against a *.workers.dev origin, so an Access app bound to a custom hostname is bypassed there. A shop being previewed by a client before launch needs this; one that is already public does not.

stagingAccessTeam.description: Zero Trust team name of the Access application in front of `stagingDomain` — the `<team>` of `https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com`. The staging Worker verifies every Access assertion against that team's keys; without it, an assertion is refused and `/admin/setup` answers 403 until an admin password exists.

stagingAccessAud.description: Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Access application in front of `stagingDomain`. Not a credential: it is the `aud` claim of every token that application issues, readable by anyone it lets through.

provider.description: Email provider. Credentials never appear here.

id.description: Theme id, matching a directory under src/themes/.

x-crossFieldRules.description: client.slug must not be a name the platform already uses.
A guest-only checkout cannot advertise customer accounts.
The French B2C market sells at tax-inclusive prices.
Features outside the certified scope stay off.
A shop is reachable on its own domain, not a platform subdomain.
The staging hostname and the production domain must differ.
cloudflare.stagingAccessTeam and cloudflare.stagingAccessAud are declared together.
An Access application for staging needs the staging hostname it is bound to.
No API key, token or secret in the manifest.
